A '''red supergiant''' was a [[supergiant]] [[Star/Legends|star]] that had progressed past the [[Star|main sequence]]. It was larger than a [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]]. [[Primus Goluud/Legends|Primus Goluud]] was a red supergiant prior to its [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]. [[Koler]] was a red supergiant located in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
